# Helvety Tasks

> Task management application with client-side encryption for sensitive fields. The main task list can be filtered in the browser after unlock by title and description (local-only search; not sent to servers). Engineered, Designed & Made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Tasks App](https://helvety.com/tasks): Auth-required task management route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Tasks routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
